propositions: A new plan-review criterion `ac-process-gate` must be added to `registry.CANONICAL_LLM` as a 1-TURN, non-codebase-grounded judgment that fires on acceptance criteria whose entire completion predicate is a generic, ticket-agnostic mechanical process/tooling gate (children-closed, tests/CI/build/lint/typecheck pass, plan-review passes, completion-verifier passes, merged/landed, commit-trailer/DCO present).

The criterion must accept (pass without finding) any AC that names or depends on the specific deliverable of the current ticket (artifact, behavior, contract, test, doc, config, criterion), even when tests/CI/plan-review are the subject.

The `ac-process-gate` routing entry in `criteria_routing.json` must have `exec: 1-TURN`, `default_posture: advisory`, `facet: ac-text-quality`, and `applies_at.scope: [container, leaf]`, with a two-key checklist (not-applicable pass for plans with no ACs; per-AC judgment of deliverable vs generic gate).

The rubric prompt `src/rebar/llm/reviewers/plan_review_ac_process_gate.md` must document the reject-set, accept-set, litmus (reads identically on arbitrary unrelated ticket), and anti-false-positive err-toward-silence rule.

The criterion implementation must pass deterministic unit tests validating registration, routing, front-matter contract, regenerated guide section, eval-spec shape (≥2 fire, ≥2 no-fire, ≤8 cases), and zero-inclusion in effectiveness-recorder auto-instruments.
Live bounded-sanity evaluation must demonstrate recall=1.0 and false_accept=0.0 on a committed eval corpus, with every process-gate AC firing and every deliverable AC passing.
